heroTitle: Expert Wildlife Control & Removal Across Canada
heroSubtext: Trusted by homeowners and businesses coast to coast. Fast, guaranteed appointments with experienced local technicians — humane, permanent, and backed by our results guarantee.

sections.title: Why Choose Greater Wildlife Control?
sections.content:
We don't just trap and go — every job is built to solve the problem for good.

  • Humane removal methods that protect animals and your property
  • Trained, insured professionals in every market we serve
  • Full damage repair — attic, roofline, insulation, and entry points
  • Guaranteed results, backed by our local service warranty

sections.title: Our Humane Removal Process
sections.content:
1. Inspection — A trained technician inspects your property to identify entry points and the species involved.
  2. Removal — Animals are humanely trapped and removed using proven, species-specific methods.
  3. Exclusion & Prevention — Entry points are sealed and reinforced so the problem doesn't come back.

sections.title: Residential & Commercial Protection
sections.content: From a single-family home to a multi-unit commercial property, our local franchise network scales to match the job — with the same rigorous standards, response times, and guaranteed results for every customer, residential or commercial.

sections.title: Wildlife Trapping
sections.content:
Our trained technicians use proven, humane trapping methods to safely remove wildlife from your property. Whether it's raccoons raiding your attic, groundhogs burrowing under your deck, or opossums in your garage, we identify the species, deploy the right traps, and ensure every animal is relocated safely and responsibly.

Every trapping job includes a full site inspection to locate all active entry points, so the problem is solved at its source — not just managed temporarily.

sections.title: Pest Control
sections.content:
From mice and rats to wasps and hornets, Greater Wildlife Control provides targeted pest control solutions that protect your home or business year-round. We go beyond surface treatment — our technicians identify harborage points, nesting sites, and food sources to eliminate infestations completely and prevent recurrence.

Our pest control programs are safe for families and pets, and every treatment comes with a follow-up inspection to confirm full resolution.

sections.title: Wildlife Prevention
sections.content:
The best wildlife removal is the kind you never need. Our prevention services seal every potential entry point — roof vents, soffits, fascia gaps, chimney caps, and foundation cracks — using commercial-grade materials designed to last for years. We back every exclusion with our results guarantee.

Pair our exclusion work with a seasonal inspection plan to stay protected as wildlife patterns shift throughout the year. Prevention is always more affordable than emergency removal.
